description: South Korea administrative fine (과태료) under 질서위반행위규제법: 20% reduction for voluntary payment within the opinion period (제18조, 시행령 제5조), 50% reduction for vulnerable people (시행령 제2조의2; the larger single reduction is applied), late-payment surcharge 3% plus 1.2% per month up to 60 months (제24조), and the opinion deadline from the notice date. Not traffic 범칙금.

fine.description: Fine amount on the advance notice (KRW)

monthsLate.description: Months past the payment due date (when late)

noticeDate.description: Date the advance notice was received, YYYY-MM-DD

opinionDays.description: Opinion period on the notice in days (at least 10, default 10)

when.description: early = within the opinion period, due = after imposition but before the payment due date, late = after the due date

title: Calculate Korea fine reduction
